lines.text: SpaceX just got the green light for a million satellites.
The FCC approved it Wednesday. Up to a million, to run AI data centers in space.
lines.say: The F.C.C. approved it Wednesday. Up to a million, to run A.I. data centers in space.

lines.text: Astronomers objected. They're worried about debris and crowded orbits. None are up there yet.

card.title: CRITICS WARN
card.body: Space debris. Crowded orbits. Radio interference.

lines.text: Eh. Space is huge. A thousand, a million, same thing.
Is it? That's a thousand times more.
Okay, but they both just feel like... a lot.
In 1993, William Desvousges asked people what they'd pay to save birds from oil ponds.
lines.say: In nineteen ninety-three, William Desvousges asked people what they'd pay to save birds from oil ponds.

card.title: DESVOUSGES · 1993
card.body: How much would you pay to save birds from oil ponds?

lines.text: 2,000 birds, or 200,000 birds. The answers barely moved. About 80 dollars.
lines.say: Two thousand birds, or two hundred thousand birds. The answers barely moved. About eighty dollars.

card.title: DESVOUSGES · 1993
card.body: How much would you pay to save birds from oil ponds?

lines.text: Your brain pictures one oily bird. Or one dot in the sky. Not the number.
So I should picture a million dots?
You can't. That's why it slips past you. Do the math instead.
Bold new frontier, or too crowded up there? Tell us in the comments.
